# Vendored Ashuffle source

- Ashuffle: https://github.com/joshkunz/ashuffle at `b144b53c2cf42d106780a8f3a859682e02e66cec` (`v3.14.10`)
- Abseil: https://github.com/abseil/abseil-cpp at `ea64b6e7e63ffd917b20609eca768e8e6eacceda`
- GoogleTest: https://github.com/google/googletest at `d72f9c8aea6817cdf1ca0ac10887f328de7f3da2`
- yaml-cpp: https://github.com/jbeder/yaml-cpp at `a83cd31548b19d50f3f983b069dceb4f4d50756d`

The files were copied without nested `.git` directories. Original licenses are
kept in this directory and in each dependency directory. `CMakeLists.txt` is
the local integration file; the upstream Meson build remains for reference.
